promptEs: En La♭ mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en V?
promptEn: In A♭ major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to V labelled?
explanationEs: En La♭ mayor, el dominante de V es Si♭7 y se cifra V/V. Resuelve en Mi♭ (V): su tercera es la sensible de Mi♭ y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In A♭ major, the dominant of V is B♭7 and it is labelled V/V. It resolves to E♭ (V): its third is the leading tone of E♭ and rises a semitone.
